name: Tapo T110 (UK)

radios.note: The UK page lists 868 / 922 MHz sub-1 GHz bands (868 MHz in Europe) to the Tapo Hub, which is not in our radio list.

matter.note: No Matter certification found for the sensor itself.

apple_home.note: The UK page doesn't mention Apple Home.

google_home.note: The UK page shows a Works with Google Home badge; the sensor needs a Tapo Hub or Homebase.

alexa.note: The UK page shows a Works with Alexa badge; the sensor needs a Tapo Hub or Homebase.

smartthings.note: The UK page doesn't mention SmartThings.

home_assistant.note: No official source found for this sensor.

hubRequired.note: The specs say a Tapo Hub (or Homebase) is needed for alerts; the download page calls the hub its bridge.

localControl.note: Not confirmed from an official source.

senses.note: Detects a door, window or drawer opening.

power.note: About 2 years per Tapo, with a low-battery alert.

summary: Door, window or drawer opening is what the Tapo T110 (UK) reports, as a push alert. Alexa and Google Home both work, but only through a Tapo Hub or Homebase, which the sensor reaches over a sub-1 GHz radio. It runs on a CR2032 coin cell rated at about 2 years. TP-Link's UK page doesn't mention Apple Home, SmartThings or Matter.
caveats: Needs a Tapo Hub for alerts; it doesn't work on its own.
Apple Home, SmartThings and Home Assistant support isn't stated by TP-Link.
